company.name: Structured AI
company.shortDescription: Structured AI builds AI-powered tools to automate repetitive workflows and make collaboration between different engineering teams seamless.
company.description: Structured AI reads building codes, standards, drawing, and project requirements to generate and update the technical documents that normally take weeks to complete. Its AI agents live inside software tools like Revit, Word, Excel, and SharePoint that mechanical, electrical, civil, and structural engineers already use.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,200,000, or 89.42% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,338,670 to $24,893,194, a 3.39x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
